name: What are common contingencies in luxury property offers?

mainEntity.name: What are common contingencies in luxury property offers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common contingencies in luxury property offers often include financing, inspection, appraisal, and title review. However, in a competitive market, minimizing or waiving certain contingencies can make an offer more attractive to a seller. For instance, a buyer with proof of funds who can waive a financing contingency presents a stronger offer. Your agent will help you determine which contingencies are essential for your protection while also making your offer competitive, especially for unique properties in locations like Fisher Island.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common contingencies are financing, inspection, appraisal, and title review, but minimizing them can strengthen your offer in competitive luxury markets.
